overview_description.description:
DRIP is a subscription-based music service that allows labels to send subscribers every album release via e-mail for a flat monthly fee. Its users have the ability to subscribe and support creators directly and get access to releases, artwork, ideas, and more. It provides users with music labels, musicians, artists, visual artists, non-profits, and more types of creators on DRIP.

DRIP is featuring direct feeds from the creators, personalized music catalogs, and a member’s area to connect. It pays creators directly, taking a small revenue share for maintenance of its service.

Founded by Miguel Senquiz and Sam Valenti IV, DRIP is based in New York, N.Y.
